description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Polygon PoS (USDC, USDT, WETH or any token, via balanceOf): raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use polygon_balance. Both inputs are 0x addresses (40 hex characters); no contract returns 404 and a non-ERC-20 contract 422, both uncharged. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC, USDT, WETH or DAI, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

title: Polygon PoS ERC-20 balance
